description.text: This program is to help student gain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Major Courses: Principles of Management, micro-economics, macro-economics, Management Information System, Statistics, Accounting, Finance Management,Marketing,Economic Law,Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management

duration.text: The Business Administration at Zhengzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2430 USD/per year ￥ 17500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters 7. certifation of no criminal record

requirements.text: Applicants should graduate from a high school, be in good health. Those who apply for this major have passed the level-3 HSK or above, Those who have failed to pass the HSK can first apply for study in the Chinese Language Programs for a full year or half year in ZZU before their major studies.
